teaser: SHarness, the secure harness we built when we could not find one: behaviour policies the Linux kernel enforces on every process an agent starts.
core_idea: An agent's rules need an enforcer outside the agent; SHarness executes Agent Behaviour Policies as Process Behaviour Policies, a small policy hashed to one name the person supplies and enforced by the kernel or a separate door, so Settings and Expectations become Boundaries an insurer can count, the prompt goes last, and one policy can be translated to many enforcers; today the kernel locks, the levels and two doors run, and the launcher above the agent is the design.

SHarness's moving parts as designed: a launcher outside every domain, the app, and five doors under mutual TLS.
